title: Local finite-stage factorization of raw relative derived classes
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed partially ordered set, DV,DB:Iᵒᵖ→Scheme diagrams with affine transition morphisms, and η:DV→DB with every η_i quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let cV,cB be limiting cones and v:cV.pt→cB.pt satisfy πV_i η_i=v πB_i. Let F_i be arbitrary abelian etale sheaves on DV_i with inverse-image coefficient maps φ_ij satisfying the identity and composition coherences. Let A be the coherent diagram of their inverse images on cV.pt, with specified isomorphisms eA_i and the corresponding arrow formula hA. Let cA be a colimit cocone and q a natural number. Put K=Rv_*cA.pt[0], K_i=D(πB_i*)Rη_i,*F_i[0] and m_i:K_i→K the derived leg [def-kun-relative-higher-image-derived-map]. For every selected geometric point s of cB.pt, pointed etale neighbourhood (U,u) and raw class z:Z[U][0]→K[q], there are a pointed refinement a:(W,w)→(U,u), a stage i, and t:Z[W][0]→K_i[q] with t m_i[q]=Z[a][0] z. The point equation is Φ_s(a)(w)=u. Conventions and constructions: [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-kun-commutative-derived-exchange], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-kun-relative-higher-image-derived-map], [def-kun-derived-homology-sections-functor], [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

proof.text: Pass to a cofinal tail and cover the chosen stage base by affine opens. Their inverse images at later stages and on the limit cover the limit base. Restricted bases are affine, restricted source schemes are qcqs by the vertical qcqs hypotheses, and the restrictions have affine transitions and the expected limits.
Use the tail-open coefficient construction on the source diagram. It supplies coherent restricted coefficients and the restriction of cA as their colimit cocone, including its legs.

Open-localization derived exchange is invertible. Apply the exchange cube to a projection square and its open restrictions; the two localization faces identify the restricted derived mate with the original mate. Coefficient naturality identifies their coefficient maps as well.

On the localized base choose an affine etale refinement of the pointed test object. The base is affine, so this refined object is finitely presented. Descend it and its structure maps to a model U_i at a stage; for j≥i put U_j=U_i times_{B_i} B_j. The point condition is retained by the refinement. Derived adjunction identifies the restricted raw morphism with cohomology on V times_B U with the restricted limiting coefficient.

For this model set $T_j=V_j\times_{B_j}U_j$ and $T=V\times_BU$. Each $T_j$ is qcqs: $T_j\to U_j$ is a base change of the qcqs $u_j$, and $U_j$ is affine. For $k\ge j$, $T_k\cong V_k\times_{V_j}T_j$, because $U_k=U_j\times_{B_j}B_k$ and the original square commutes. Thus $T_k\to T_j$ is affine, even though $V_k\to V_j$ need not be a base change of $B_k\to B_j$. The projections exhibit $T=\varprojlim_{j\ge i}T_j$: maps to the $T_j$ amount to compatible maps to the $V_j$ and $U_j$ with equal images in the $B_j$, hence to maps to $V$ and $U$ with equal images in $B$. Restrict $A_j$ to $T_j$ and call it $A_{j,T_j}$. The induced coefficient system has limit coefficient $A|_T$, since inverse images compose and commute with colimits. The cohomology-continuity theorem for varying abelian sheaves consequently gives the canonical isomorphism
$$\alpha_U:\varinjlim_{j\ge i}H^q(T_j,A_{j,T_j})\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(T,A|_T).$$
The maps are exactly pullback on cohomology followed by the coefficient transitions. This argument applies after any replacement of $U_i$ by an affine etale object at any later stage.

proof.text: Represent the raw morphism by its chart cohomology class via derived adjunction. After the affine localization above, refine the pointed test object by affine etale charts and descend one such chart and its maps to a stage. Apply cohomology continuity to the source fibre products and the restricted coefficient system. The class is the image of a finite-stage class. Transpose it back by derived adjunction, pull it to the limiting base using the free-sheaf single and shift comparisons, and call the resulting raw morphism t. Naturality of adjunction and mate pasting identify t followed by the shifted derived leg with the restriction of the given raw morphism z. The pointed chart supplies W,a,w and the point equation. The open-restriction cube from the preceding steps identifies this leg with the original, unrestricted mate.

theorem relativeHigherDirectImage_raw_local_factorization
    {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (DV DB : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (η : DV ⟶ DB)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (DV.map a)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (DB.map a)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (η.app i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (η.app i)]
    (cV : Cone DV) (hcV : IsLimit cV) (cB : Cone DB) (hcB : IsLimit cB)
    (v : cV.pt ⟶ cB.pt)
    (hu : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, cV.π.app i ≫ η.app i = v ≫ cB.π.app i)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (DV.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.map a.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (DV.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hφcomp : ∀ (i j k : I) (a : i ⟶ j) (b : j ⟶ k),
      φ (a ≫ b) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.map b.op) (DV.map a.op)
          (DV.map (a ≫ b).op) (DV.map_comp b.op a.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (DV.map b.op)).map (φ a) ≫ φ b)
    (A : I ⥤ Sheaf cV.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eA : ∀ i : I, A.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cV.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hA : ∀ (i j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), A.map a =
      (eA i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cV.π.app (op j)) (DV.map a.op)
          (cV.π.app (op i)) (cV.w a.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cV.π.app (op j))).map (φ a) ≫ (eA j).inv)
    (cA : Cocone A) (hcA : IsColimit cA) (q : ℕ)
    (s : cB.pt) (U : cB.pt.Etale)
    (u₀ : (cB.pt.uliftPointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj U)
    (z : ((derivedHomologySectionsFunctor cB.pt (q : ℤ)).obj
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj cA.pt))).obj (op U)) :
    ∃ (W : cB.pt.Etale) (a : W ⟶ U)
      (w : (cB.pt.uliftPointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj W),
      (cB.pt.uliftPointSmallEtale s).fiber.map a w = u₀ ∧
      ∃ (i : I)
        (t : ((derivedHomologySectionsFunctor cB.pt (q : ℤ)).obj
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cB.π.app (op i))).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
            ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (η.app (op i))).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (F i))))).obj (op W)),
        ((derivedHomologySectionsFunctor cB.pt (q : ℤ)).map
          (relativeHigherDirectImageDerivedMap ⟨hu (op i)⟩ (F i) cA.pt
            ((eA i).inv ≫ cA.ι.app i))).app (op W) t =
          ((derivedHomologySectionsFunctor cB.pt (q : ℤ)).obj
            ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj cA.pt))).map a.op z
